profile.headline: Business Systems & Technical Delivery | Software, Integrations & Automation
profile.summary: I build and improve business systems, working with clients, business teams, and engineers from requirements through delivery.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Built Customs Edge’s HTS classification system for clients including UFC, cutting trade lookup time from hours to minutes across ~100 shipments a week.
Worked with UFC’s VP of Procurement and ops teams to define requirements and prioritize features, including OCR for scanned manifests.
Broke projects into engineering tasks, assigned work, and tracked progress to meet delivery dates.
Built backend services in TypeScript, NestJS, and PostgreSQL, alongside React tools for client operations teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Delivered Cornerstone, FreshRealm’s fulfillment platform serving Walmart, Kroger, Trader Joe’s, and D2C brands at hundreds of thousands of orders a day.
Took over Cornerstone behind schedule and over budget, reset scope and executive expectations, and delivered on the agreed timeline.
Coordinated delivery across a team of ~20, including internal engineers, QA staff, and contractors, running sprint planning, estimates, and progress reviews.
Worked directly with retailer engineering teams on requirements and integrations using EDI, FTP, and APIs.
Built backend services and React and Angular applications supporting fulfillment operations. Set up production observability and logging and covered on-call incidents.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Built the backend for a UK custom golf equipment marketplace serving hundreds of customers and ~100 vendor shops, using Python/Flask, Laravel, and Docker Compose.
Worked directly with business owners to define requirements, priorities, and delivery dates.
Delivered custom equipment configurations and a geo-matching bidding system that routed customer bids to nearby shops.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned login pages on Chase’s shared Python and JavaScript platform.
Integrated SSO and JWT authentication across 10–20 internal applications.
Added automated testing during the login-page modernization, increasing coverage from 30% to around 80%.

positions.title: Platform Operations Engineer
positions.description:
• Managed and built out Chase's internal analytics infrastructure including Adobe Analytics, SQL databases, nodes, load balancers, and scheduled automation pipelines via Control-M
• Automated data migration and reporting workflows in Python, saving analytics teams 10+ hours a week
• Created KPI dashboards so internal analyst teams could self-serve reporting without engineering tickets
• Analyzed behavioral data across 100+ Chase web and mobile properties, producing reports and recommendations for engineering and business teams

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Automated direct-mail and email campaign analytics using SQL and Oracle Siebel, improving data accuracy and reducing manual reporting.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
